'''Todoroki Shrine''' (轟神社, Todoroki Jinja)
* {{ill|Todoroki Shrine (Anan)|ja|轟神社 (阿南市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Todoroki Shrine (Anan)}} - A shrine located in {{ill|Anan, Tokushima|en|Anan, Tokushima|qid=Q485583|lt=Anan, Tokushima}}, Tokushima Prefecture, in Niino Town.
